chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qurashi al-Razzaz narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to me from Musa ibn Sa'dan al-Hannat, from Abdullah ibn Qasim al-Hadrami, from Salih ibn Sahl, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted and Mighty:
And We made known to the Children of Israel in the Book
You will certainly make mischief in the land twice. He said: The killing of the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) and the stabbing of al-Hasan ibn Ali (peace be upon him).
And you will certainly become exceedingly arrogant
The killing of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him).
So when the promise of the first of the two comes
He said: When the avenging of the blood of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) comes
We sent over you servants of Ours, of great prowess, so they invaded the very inmost parts of your houses
A group whom Allah sends before the rising of the Qa'im (peace be upon him); they do not leave a single one of the family of Muhammad (peace be upon him) except that they burn him.
And it was a promise to be fulfilled

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers (Ali ibn Abi Talib)
key_terms.نَصْرُ الْحُسَيْنِ: The avenging of the blood of Husayn

ai.seo_question: What are the two mischiefs in the land mentioned in Surah Al-Isra?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) provides a seminal Shia exegesis of Surah Al-Isra (17:4-5), interpreting the 'two corruptions' as the martyrdoms of Ali and Hasan, and the 'great arrogance' as that of Husayn. The 'promise of the first' is identified with the rise of the avenger of Husayn's blood, while the 'servants with great might' are understood as a specific group dispatched before the Qa'im to eradicate the remaining progeny of Muhammad, emphasizing the continuity of divine retribution and the lineage's suffering.
